visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at a traditional temple entrance with stone-carved dragon pillars. An elderly man in an orange polo shirt stands between two young hosts: a woman in a black t-shirt and blue cap, and a man in a green t-shirt. They are gesturing towards traditional lion dance masks. The lighting is bright natural daylight, and the background features intricate temple architecture and red pillars. (2) A close-up shot focuses on two Hakka-style lion dance masks. These masks are square-shaped, painted green with red accents, featuring large bulging eyes, bushy eyebrows, and a red interior mouth with white teeth. The textures appear to be painted wood and fabric. The man's hands are seen demonstrating the mechanics of the lion's mouth. (3) The hosts attempt to put on the heavy lion masks and matching yellow capes. The young woman in the black shirt and the young man in green are seen struggling, with their bodies tilted under the weight. Their facial expressions convey effort and amusement. The background remains the temple foyer with various ceremonial objects visible. (4) A fast-paced montage depicts a staged 'Lion Dance Competition.' The hosts are seen wearing the full lion costumes, performing clunky, uncoordinated movements. The elderly man is seen in the background playing a large traditional drum. On-screen captions and variety show graphics frequently appear at the center and bottom of the frame. (5) The hosts are seen removing the masks, appearing physically exhausted and sweaty. They wipe their foreheads and catch their breath while talking to the camera. The elderly man stands nearby, smiling. The camera uses handheld medium shots to capture their reactions and the surrounding temple environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with clear, moderate-pitched conversational speech between three main speakers. The young female host has a bright, inquisitive tone. The male host sounds energetic. There is no BGM, only faint room tone. (2) A transition occurs with a short 'whoosh' SFX followed by traditional Chinese percussion BGM. The drum beats are steady and powerful, using a large Chinese drum with high-frequency wooden stick impacts. The BGM maintains a traditional pentatonic vibe. (3) During the physical challenge, the speakers' voices exhibit breathiness and strain, indicating physical exertion. Frequent cartoonish 'pop' and 'boing' sound effects are layered over the visuals to emphasize clunky movements. (4) The drum BGM intensifies in tempo during the 'competition' segment. Percussive drum rolls are synchronized with the chaotic movements of the lion masks. Short, sharp 'ding' and 'hit' SFX punctuate the edits. (5) The video concludes with the hosts speaking in a high-arousal, joyful, yet exhausted manner. The BGM fades into a lighter, comedic orchestral track. Laughter from behind the camera is occasionally audible.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Demonstration -> Challenge -> Performance -> Reflection
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain while introducing traditional Hakka lion dance culture through a comedic 'experience' format. By showing the hosts' genuine struggle with the heavy masks and their clunky performance, it highlights the skill required for the craft in a lighthearted way.
